changelog:
Initial release of financial-wealth-management skill.

- Provides tools for wealth management and financial advisory, including client reviews, financial planning, portfolio analysis, and reporting.
- Includes commands for generating client performance reports, prepping for client review meetings, building/updating financial plans, portfolio rebalancing, and tax-loss harvesting.
- Integrates detailed workflows for client review and financial plan creation, covering account analysis, performance metrics, cash flow, and retirement projections.
- Sourced from the official Anthropic financial-services repository.
